title: Trip editor
goal: The owner builds a trip from places
acceptance: Create a trip, set dates and from/to
Pick stops from places (search, category and tag filters) or add one on the fly, which creates a place
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
